name: minecraft-dev
description: Minecraft development skills and tools for DeepSeek Harness: Paper/Spigot server plugins (modern and legacy lines), Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, MC 1.7.10 through 26.x, plus the mc_gradle Gradle runner, a second agent preset (Minecraft 架构师 / Astra神的瞥视) whose mc_codex tool drives the user's own Codex CLI as a transparent architect and hands content back through [TODO: Agent B] markers + FILL-SPEC.md, modern major-mod references (Create/Botania/AE2/Mekanism/Ars Nouveau/Farmer's Delight/Curios/JEI/REI/Patchouli), the minecraft-intake task-clarification skill (batch-ask when version/platform/loader details are missing), the check-doc-links link verifier, and a built-in A/B/C/D four-subagent team (subagent_mc_plan/skeleton/content/verify)

permissions.filesystem: mc_scaffold writes files under the user-specified targetDir only; mc_codex writes the architecture brief and the last-message file under <projectDir>/.dsh/; minecraft-preset may write the bundled agent presets into $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets on boot (skipped when already present)
permissions.subprocess: mc_gradle executes gradlew inside the user-specified project directory; mc_codex runs the Codex CLI the user already installed with <projectDir> as its working directory (only from the Minecraft 架构师 preset) — by default through the official `codex app-server --stdio` protocol, which creates a real Codex session visible in the Codex desktop app, or via `codex exec` when mode=exec is requested
